changes.old: His parents now reside at the 56-hectare Orsival estate nearby, Galahad has returned to his Collegium room in Auvrienne to complete expedition preparations.
changes.new: His parents reside at the 56-hectare Orsival estate nearby. Following his 12–17/10 visit it has a telephone and two watchhounds. His private papers and former Collegium belongings arrived on 22/10. Galahad is now directing the completed rifle pilot programme in Auvrienne; five approved household rifles still await delivery.

changes.old: Institutional and professional connections support his expanding research.
changes.new: Institutional and professional connections support his research. Galahad resigned salaried Collegium employment on 20/10, donated patronage and moved his personal belongings to the estate. He now directs the allocated military works: 192 accepted trial rifles and three development rifles completed by 02/11, awaiting dispatch arrangements and controlled demonstration. The standing Royal Advisor appointment remains under review.
